mapper.select: SELECT client_idx AS clientIdx, org_code AS orgCode, org_name AS orgName, client_id AS clientId, client_secret AS clientSecret, redirect_uri AS redirectUri, created_at AS createdAt FROM mock_clients WHERE client_id = #{clientId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mock_authorizations ( ci, org_code, code, app_scheme, is_used, expires_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{ci}, #{orgCode}, #{code}, #{appScheme}, #{isUsed}, #{expiresAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT connection_id AS connectionId, ci, org_code AS orgCode, code, app_scheme AS appScheme, is_used AS isUsed, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM mock_authorizations WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mock_transactions ( x_api_tran_id, connection_id, state, api_url, created_at ) VALUES ( #{xApiTranId}, #{connectionId}, #{state}, #{apiUrl}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mock_transactions WHERE x_api_tran_id = #{tranId}
